whatsappMessage:
Hi Bluemoon Team,

I noticed your restaurant has phenomenal 4.0★ reviews with over 2,700 feedback in Sri Krishna Puri, Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and table reservation page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, digital food menu, aur special dish showcase integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/bluemoon

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Bluemoon Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Bluemoon on Boring Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with a digital menu, direct WhatsApp table reservation, and mobile-first speed for your customers in Boring Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact food menu, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
